div.div:
Farm-to-Market — Conceptual ER diagram
COSC444 Database Systems · Khalifa University · Lab B1 · Chen notation with (min,max) participation

div.div:
How to read
Rectangle = entity; diamond = relationship; ellipse = relationship attribute.
(min,max) beside an entity = how many times one instance of that entity takes part in the relationship. Example: FARM (1,1) LOCATED IN EMIRATE (0,N) — every farm is in exactly one emirate; an emirate may have none or many farms.
underlined = identifier; /name = derived (computed, not entered).
* minimum guaranteed by the application, not by SQL: every lot gets a HARVEST_ADDED movement, every allocation a RESERVED movement and every request a 'Request created' status row in the same transaction.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 125, 50), rgb(100, 168, 104));

div.div:
Key business rules shown by the model
R1 A farm runs many crop cycles; each lot comes from exactly one cycle, so a lot's crop and farm are derived through its cycle (BR-01).
R2 expected_quantity is a forecast on CROP_CYCLE. Stock exists only on HARVEST_LOT and is never mixed with the forecast (BR-02).
R3 /on_hand, /reserved, /available are derived from the dated STOCK_MOVEMENT ledger, never stored (BR-03).
R4 ALLOCATION links one request to one lot. A request can be split across many lots (partial fulfilment) and a lot can supply many requests. An allocation can never exceed the lot's available quantity (BR-04, application-enforced under a lot row lock).
R5 At most one DELIVERY_RECEIPT per allocation (UNIQUE). It records the received quantity; the shortfall is stored as the discrepancy, released from the reservation and recorded as LOSS (BR-05).
R6 Every quantity is in an explicit UNIT. Allocations, receipts and movements carry the lot's unit; equality with the lot/request unit is application-enforced. There is no conversion (BR-06).
R7 Only farmers are ASSIGNED TO farms; only market buyers BUY FOR exactly one market (SQL CHECK chk_user_market). Administrators have neither link (BR-07).
R8 Each STOCK_MOVEMENT, REQUEST_STATUS_CHANGE, CROP_CYCLE, HARVEST_LOT, LOT_IMAGE, MARKET_REQUEST, ALLOCATION and DELIVERY_RECEIPT records exactly one responsible USER: USER (0,N) — record (1,1). These eight accountability links are drawn on relational schema page 5 (BR-08).
R9 Every LOT_IMAGE belongs to exactly one lot and stores JPEG/PNG bytes (BLOB) (BR-09).
R10 Reference entities and users are deactivated (is_active), not deleted, so history is kept.
